description: Add a labor worker, or edit one, as the labor resources screen does: their name, the Spark account they sign in with (which gives them a my-work page), and whether they are archived. Omit worker to add one (firstName required); name an existing worker by id or full name (get_labor_resources) to edit it, and leave out what stays the same. Archived workers drop out of new plans, pools and calendars. Refused, as on the screen, while the worker has a session running and the edit archives them or changes their sign-in. Admin; operator credentials only. Preview first; the in-app assistant gets a confirm card.

account.description: The email of the internal Spark account the worker signs in with; it must not be linked to another worker.

archived.description: true archives the worker, false restores them; omit to keep as is.

firstName.description: First name, at most 120 characters; required for a new worker.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

lastName.description: Last name, at most 120 characters; an empty string clears it.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

unlinkAccount.description: true removes the worker's sign-in link.

worker.description: The worker to edit, by id or full name; omit to add a new worker.

name: save_labor_worker
title: Save Labor Worker
